meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
₹500 ke andar **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash** sabse accha overall option hai—especially agar oily skin ke saath blackheads, clogged pores ya pimples bhi hain. Iski price aam taur par ₹278–₹299/100 ml ke aas-paas milti hai.[2][3]

**Skin concern ke hisaab se options:**

- **Oily + acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — ₹299 ke aas-paas.[2]
- **Sensitive oily skin:** Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Face Wash — lagbhag ₹224–₹450.[1][8]
- **Budget daily cleanser:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — lagbhag ₹120–₹250.[1][6]
- **Oily + dull skin:** Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash — lagbhag ₹239–₹349.[6][8]
- **Oily skin, lekin acids avoid karne hain:** The Derma Co. 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser — ₹500 se kam options mein milta hai.[10]

**Meri recommendation:**  
Minimalist cleanser ko pehle **raat mein ek baar**, 20–30 seconds ke liye use karein. Agar dryness, jalan ya redness ho, to use alternate days kar dein. Face wash ke baad lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur din mein sunscreen lagana zaroori hai. Salicylic-acid face wash ko overuse na karein.
